laws.rule: Buenos Aires province (Ley 15.402, in force from 5 January 2023, amending the provincial traffic code Ley 13.927): driving any motor vehicle with any alcohol in the blood (above 0 mg per litre) is prohibited, as is driving after taking medicines or substances the authority lists as reducing fitness to drive. Police can hold a driver found intoxicated for up to 12 hours and keep the licence. Refusing or obstructing a breath test is a serious offence that triggers licence retention and disqualification.
laws.penalty_signal: A fine plus driving disqualification: 3 months up to 499 mg per litre; 6 months for 500 to 999; 12 months for 1,000 to 1,500; 18 months above 1,500. Arrest is also listed among the penalties.
